name: Expel the Interlopers
oracle_text: Choose a number between 0 and 10. Destroy all creatures with power greater than or equal to the chosen number.
blocked_sentences: Choose a number between 0 and 10. Destroy all creatures with power greater than or equal to the chosen number.

needs.what: an op that asks the controller, on resolution, to choose an integer in a printed range (here 0..10) and binds it under `as`, so a later selector can compare against it -- e.g. destroy with objects {zone: battlefield, controller: any, types: [Creature], power: {op: '>=', value: {binding: 'chosen'}}}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op chooses a number. choose_mode over eleven destroy modes is the near miss, but a top-level choose_mode is answered at cast time (count_mode_specs / cast-time mode selection), which turns this non-modal sorcery into a modal spell (700.2) and announces the number on the stack instead of choosing it on resolution; it would also count as modal for anything that cares. roll_dice binds a random number, not a chosen one, and x/may.any_amount are tied to paying mana
